verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe AI Gateway as a single endpoint to "hundreds of models". It can be called through the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL, and adds fallbacks across providers, budgets, and usage monitoring. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the gateway works as described, and a documented model catalog or count backing the "hundreds of models" claim.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
